summary: NOT A BRAND REPRODUCTION. ohou.se refused automated observation, so this pack carries the Korean content-commerce pattern (photo-led feed, price-below-image cards, bottom tab bar) and no observed Ohouse value. Every value here is a generic pattern, not a measurement.
accessNote: https://ohou.se/ and https://ohou.se/store returned HTTP 403 to both a plain fetch and headless Chromium on 2026-09-06 (a browser HEAD returns 200, so the block targets automation). Bot protection was not circumvented. Until someone supplies screenshots or an observation run from an allowed context, no value in this pack may be described as Ohouse's.
upgradePath: Ask the user for screenshots of the target page (mobile 390 and desktop 1440), or run scripts/observe.mjs from a context ohou.se allows. Then rewrite tokens/typeScale/layout with evidence: observed and set evidenceStatus accordingly. Do not upgrade any field without a provenance entry.

--background.note: Korean content-commerce feeds put photography on a white canvas so product colour is not tinted. Generic pattern.

--card.note: A barely-tinted second surface separates feed sections without borders. Generic pattern.

--muted-foreground.note: Metadata (author, view count, category) sits one step down.

--primary.note: PLACEHOLDER HUE, not Ohouse's. The lineage rule applies: replace the hue from the brief's objects (adaptation.md knob 1). Korean commerce homes use one action accent for CTA and the current tab.

--destructive.note: Korean commerce marks discount rate and price in a warm alert hue distinct from the action accent, which maps onto the existing --destructive role. Generic pattern, not an Ohouse value.

--radius.note: Card and image corners in this category are soft but not pill-like. Generic pattern.

--font-sans.note: Korean-complete family required by typography-ko.md. This is our own rule, not an observation of Ohouse.

typeScale.note: Korean UI headings are small and bold rather than large and light, because Hangul reads heavy at size.
Price outweighs the title in a commerce card.

slots.role: search-first header: logo, search field, account
slots.note: Content-commerce puts search in the header because the catalogue is the product.

slots.role: the page: a masonry or equal-column grid of photo cards, image first, text below
slots.note: The dominant band. Image aspect drives the rhythm; text is a caption under it.

slots.role: horizontally scrolling product cards with price

slots.note: Korean app-like web homes keep a fixed bottom tab bar on mobile.

layout.macro: search-header → category rail → photo feed → product strip → bottom tab bar (mobile)

photo-card.pattern: Image fills the card top edge to edge at a fixed ratio; title, price and metadata stack below on the image's left edge. No border, no shadow — the photo is the surface.

price-block.pattern: Discount rate then price on one line, both tabular; original price struck through beside them when discounted.

bottom-tab.pattern: Five items, icon over 10-11px label, the current item carries the accent and the others are muted.

responsive.change: Feed goes from 2 columns to 4; the bottom tab bar is replaced by header navigation.

content.images: Photography is the content. Reserve a fixed aspect box (4:3 or 1:1) and use a neutral placeholder block — never a stock photo standing in for a brand asset.
content.copy: Korean, word-break: keep-all, short noun phrases. Placeholder prices and product names only.

allowedModifications: Everything. This pack is a starting pattern, not a source: the lineage rules in adaptation.md win on every conflict.
Replace --accent with the hue derived from the brief's objects — the value here is an explicit placeholder.
Apply typography-ko.md over any value in this pack.
forbidden: Saying or implying that any value here was observed from ohou.se.
Copying Ohouse's logo, photography, product names, copy or code.
Circumventing the HTTP 403 (headers, proxies, scraping services) to fill this pack.

coverageNote: Light theme only. No dark-theme pattern is asserted because none was observed and Korean content-commerce feeds are predominantly light. Every value is unverified.
